name: Relaxing
overview: Scripture reveals that true relaxation and peace come from trusting in the LORD’s protection and care, as seen in Psalms where the believer rests securely under God's watchful presence. The Psalms emphasize that God is our Shepherd who provides and shelters us, enabling us to lay down in peace without fear. Additionally, Proverbs and Ecclesiastes encourage removing sorrow and embracing uplifting words to restore joy and ease heaviness of heart, highlighting the spiritual and emotional aspects of relaxation rooted in God’s truth and comfort.
